Initially for one year; extendable based on performance and project tenure

content_sections.heading: About IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Indore is a government technical institute at Khandwa Road, Simrol, Indore 453552, Madhya Pradesh. The JRF post is in an ANRF-PMECRG research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Vivek Verma of the Department of Metallurgical Engineering and Materials Science. The project aims to unravel thermomigration behavior in high-entropy solder alloy systems through computational thermodynamics, diffusion modeling and experimental characterization, enabling predictive design of thermally stable advanced materials for next-generation electronics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must meet one of these three options: M.Tech./ M.E./ M.S. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering. Candidates with MTech/ME/MS degrees in these disciplines should have previously qualified GATE once. OR B.Tech./ B.E. or equivalent degree in Metallurgical Engineering/ Materials Science and Engineering/ Metallurgical and Materials Engineering/ Mechanical Engineering/ Manufacturing/ Production Engineering/ Engineering Physics, with a valid GATE score. OR M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology, with a valid GATE score OR Equivalent Fellowship. Strong foundation in physical metallurgy, thermodynamics and mechanical behavior. Understanding of phase transformations, diffusion phenomena, microstructure–property relationships and strengthening mechanisms in metallic systems. Experience in materials characterization techniques and/or mechanical property evaluation. Proficiency in scientific computing tools, Thermo-Calc and DICTRA. The age limit for the JRF post is a maximum of 28 years. The notice does not mention a date on which age is counted. The notice says strong preference will be given to candidates who are interested in pursuing a PhD at IIT Indore. Candidates with clear research motivation and long-term commitment to doctoral studies will be prioritized. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Fellowship: ₹37,000 per month + HRA. Accommodation: An institute hostel may be provided, subject to availability. Otherwise, HRA will be applicable. Duration: Initially for one year. It is extendable based on performance and project tenure. Nature of appointment: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Combine all the required qualification documents into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Use this exact subject line: Application for the position of JRF (ANRF-PMECRG project) . Send the email by 10 November 2026 . Curriculum Vitae Statement of Purpose Self-attested copies of educational certificates GATE scorecard List of publications (if any) Any other relevant documents The office phone number on the IIT Indore letterhead is +91 731 2438733, and the fax number is +91 731 2438 721.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not by itself guarantee an interview call. Interview call: Shortlisted candidates will be told about the interview by email. Interview mode: The interview will be held online. The meeting link will be shared only with shortlisted candidates. The notice does not mention an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Indore JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) vacancy in the ANRF-PMECRG project at IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The deadline to email the application is 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need one of three options in the listed disciplines: an M.Tech./M.E./M.S. or equivalent with GATE qualified once, a B.Tech./B.E. or equivalent with a valid GATE score, or an M.Sc. in Materials Science, Physics, Nanoscience and Technology with a valid GATE score or an equivalent fellowship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the IIT Indore JRF post is a maximum of 28 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Indore JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the IIT Indore JRF fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + HRA. An institute hostel may be provided subject to availability; otherwise HRA will be applicable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Email a single PDF with all the required qualification documents to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the position of JRF (ANRF-PMECRG project)" by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates will be shortlisted based on merit and project requirements, and shortlisted candidates will have an online interview. They will receive the interview details and meeting link by email.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIT Indore JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. It is initially for one year and extendable based on performance and project tenure.

faq.question: Q10. Do candidates interested in a PhD get preference for the IIT Indore JRF post?
faq.answer: Yes, strong preference will be given to candidates interested in pursuing a PhD at IIT Indore. Candidates with clear research motivation and long-term commitment to doctoral studies will be prioritized.
